breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt had conflicting boundary conditions, specifying both Dirichlet (u=0 on the boundary) and periodic conditions. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly includes only the Dirichlet condition: 'Apply Dirichlet boundary condition u = 0 on the entire boundary ∂((0,1) x (0,1))' and omits any mention of periodicity, thus fixing the error.
